facts.fact: Aviso n.º 1/GBM/2026 of 25 February 2026 is issued by the Banco de Moçambique under Lei n.º 2/2008 of 27 February, the Lei do Sistema Nacional de Pagamentos, which the notice treats as the enabling payments law at that date.
facts.system: Lei do Sistema Nacional de Pagamentos (Lei n.º 2/2008)

facts.fact: Article 8 of the Regulation annexed to Aviso n.º 1/GBM/2026 makes participation in the Mozambique Instant Payment System (SPIM) compulsory for electronic money institutions and for credit institutions with 5,000 active accounts or 10,000 transfers a year; Article 7 also requires participants to be connected to the national electronic payments network; in force 2 March 2026.

systems.system: Sistema de Pagamentos Instantâneos de Moçambique (SPIM)
systems.owner: Sociedade Interbancária de Moçambique (SIMO), operator and manager
systems.tiers: credit institutions, electronic money institutions, payment service companies, others authorised by the Banco de Moçambique
